title: Charcoal BBQ Grill SATAH with Smoker Metal Black
description:
Portable BBQ Smoker
This charcoal BBQ grill with an integrated smoker is a practical choice for outdoor cooking in the garden or patio, combining traditional grilling with the ability to smoke various foods. Made from durable metal, it offers resistance to high temperatures and ensures long-lasting utility even with regular use. The smoker makes it possible to infuse meats, fish or vegetables with deep flavour and smoky aroma, offering a versatile cooking solution that suits both quick BBQs and slower, flavour-focused preparations. The sturdy frame guarantees stability during grilling, while two wheels and the side handle allow for easy relocation. Its straightforward, low-maintenance design makes cleaning simple after each use, and the modern look fits well into a diverse garden or terrace arrangements, making this grill ideal for anyone who enjoys outdoor cooking with added smoking functionality.

title: Gas Fire Pit KATMAI Concrete Light Grey
description:
Outdoor Gas Fireplace
Create a warm and inviting atmosphere in your garden or patio with this modern square gas fireplace, designed to combine visual appeal with functional comfort, perfect for cold evenings. Crafted from high-quality, glass fibre reinforced concrete, the construction offers excellent durability, resistance to cracking, and protection against weather conditions, ensuring years of trouble-free use. Fuelled by propane, this fire pit offers adjustable flame without ash or smoke, making it a cleaner and easier to control alternative to traditional wood-burning options. The minimal form complements both modern and traditional outdoor arrangements, while the included lava rocks enhance the flame’s visual effect, making this a perfect piece for relaxed outdoor gatherings.

title: Fire Pit TANARA Metal Black
description:
Patio Firebowl with BBQ
This modern fire pit combines patio heating with open-fire grilling in a single compact unit. A removable grill grate spans the wide steel bowl, providing space to sear steaks, roast vegetables or toast marshmallows directly over the flames. Extra wood or charcoal can be stored on the open shelf beneath the bowl, keeping fuel close at hand and supporting steady airflow for an even burn. Efficient ventilation around the bowl promotes consistent combustion and radiates warmth to surrounding seating areas. Weather-resistant powder-coated steel construction ensures year-round durability while the minimalist form creates a clean, contemporary focal point for any garden or terrace.

title: Grill Fire Pit YATE Metal Black
description:
Chimney Fire Pit with BBQ
This outdoor fire pit in the shape of a chimney offers more than just a striking visual accent to your garden or patio – thanks to added accessories, it’s a functional fireplace that brings a cosy atmosphere and allows outdoor cooking. Constructed from top-quality steel, it is resistant to both high and low temperatures, built to last through many seasons of regular use, guaranteeing pleasant warmth during cold evenings. Additionally, this fire pit includes all the essentials for outdoor grilling, such as a BBQ grate for preparing food directly over the flames and a practical ash pan for effortless cleaning after each use. The piece is perfectly suited for long outdoor gatherings, whether you're grilling vegetables, roasting sausages, or simply enjoying the ambient glow of a real wood fire.

title: Mini Charcoal BBQ Grill KAMADO Ceramic Black
description:

title: Charcoal BBQ Grill PAVLOF Metal Black
description:
Black Cart BBQ Smoker
A practical charcoal BBQ grill with a lid and built-in thermometer, ideal for outdoor cooking with full temperature control. title: Grill Fire Pit NEGARA Metal Black
description:
Bowl Shaped Garden Fire Pit
